name: Small Ale
description:
A thin, lightly fermented barley ale with a faint bread-crust aroma. Drawn from the everyday cask rather than the innkeeper's strong stock.

One purchase supplies one pint of ale. The inn retains its serving vessel; takeaway requires your own suitable container. Alcohol effects are left to the GM.
